title: The Thicker Painting
premise_public: A guard stared at a famous painting that looked exactly as it had the day before. He noticed its frame was slightly thicker and immediately called the police.
solution_summary: A thief had swapped the original canvas for a convincing reproduction. Extra backing material behind the replacement changed the frame's depth, which the familiar guard noticed.

facts.text: The displayed image was a convincing reproduction.
The original canvas had been stolen.
Extra backing material made the replacement thicker.
The guard knew the painting's normal dimensions.

acceptable_solutions: A thief replaced the original painting with a copy that had thicker backing.
It was a reproduction in a thicker frame; the real art was stolen.
The canvas was swapped and the substitute was thicker because of extra support.
hints: Looking at the image itself was not enough.
The clue was in the object's construction, not the depicted scene.
